unit.why: A reported anecdote, told by R. David of Charsel, about the Maggid's custom of singing in vernacular (Slavic) languages, with one Purim occasion on which he sang and gave an interpretation of the song.

stories.start_quote: הה״ג מו"ה דוד אבד״ק חארזיל סיפר לי
stories.summary_en: R. David of Charsel relates that the Maggid used to sing in Slavic languages, and on Purim sang a song linking Purim to the 'night of watching', then after the rejoicing interpreted another vernacular song as being about nullifying the body's powers ('the shirt is the body').

quotes: היה דרכו של המגיד לזמר בלשון העמים
